thread:
mia: Heads-up — big spike in unclaimed leads this morning. ~4k in intake queue, enrichment lagging. A bunch of webinar leads timed out before round-robin claim. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: saw it. enrichment batch job slowed after the 03:15 deploy, enrichment-worker-3 CPU+IO spiked, lots of backpressure. I requeued ~800 leads to retry.

oliver: did we have a fallback to direct-assign when enrichment > 45s? I thought we had a fast-path for webinar leads.

mia: we do, but it only triggers when enrichment_complete=true. since the enrichment job was delayed, those stayed unclaimed and hit SLA timeouts.

jordan: quick mitigation proposal: if lead.source == "webinar" && time_since_ingest > 30s && enrichment_status != "complete" then route to fast-path -> overflow pool with a short TTL (2m). keeps Sales pipelines warm.

sam: +1 to the overflow TTL. also add small jitter to RR slots to avoid a thundering herd when the backlog drains (slot_jitter_ms = 2000).

oliver: sample HubSpot workflow / filter we can push now:
```
IF Original_Source = "Webinar" AND Enrichment_Status != "complete" AND Minutes_Since_Ingest > 0.5
THEN Set Property: RoutingOverride = "fast-path-overflow"
Set Property: RoutingTTL = "120"
```
(this maps to our intake webhook which will treat RoutingOverride specially)

mia: Jordan — can you run the canary for the routing-service patch? I'll notify Sales Ops. /cc @sam @oliver 

jordan: starting canary now. kicking off 10% traffic to the new fast-path route.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for routing-service v1.42.1 -> 3 pods. Logs: https://ci.redwood/xc/517222.

sam: monitoring: added a temporary alert on unclaimed_leads_rate > 200/min and enrichment_queue_length > 500. will also watch assign_latency P99.

oliver: also recommend bumping the HubSpot webhook timeout from 5s -> 10s during this window to reduce transient failures while enrichment is congested.

jordan: quick Salesforce fallback rule draft:
```
Rule: If LeadSource = "Webinar" AND Enrichment_Complete__c = False AND Age__Minutes__c > 30
Then Owner = "Overflow Team" // temporary until enrichment clears
```
We can enable with a constraint on OwnerChangeAudit to revert after TTL.

mia: sounds good. after canary bake (20m) we'll promote to 100% and update the playbook doc with the new fast-path rule and TTLs.

sam: postmortem note (prelim): root cause = enrichment batch scheduling + insufficient RR jitter. we'll space batches and add a backpressure signal to intake.

mia: thanks team — I'll send a short status update to sales-ops and add a note to the incident playbook. :thumbsup:

[end thread]
